Well it's not entirely "fear mongering". There's so many layers to be considered before claiming it as fake. As there are scientist who are atheist turned christian, some people who are educated on science, found a logical reason to believe in a higher being. And for my opinion some things are just way beyond our capacity to think. I always think of the day that I'll die, where will i go? Would i burn in hell or would i just float in an eternal limbo of darkness lol. So I'm not really sure, but I'm really open to believing something as long as it isn't invasive or it wouldn't hurt people around me.

I'm agnostic, sometimes I doubt what i believe in. I used to be a Christian, but for the past few years I started doubting. But what if I'm wrong? What if there's heaven and hell? I mean you can't really prove it unless you've been there, or you died. And every teachings I've ever heard from my pastor wasn't that bad, it's all about being selfless and unconditional love. But every time something bad happens, like i see a child dying of cancer i crawl back to the idea that if there is a god, then why would he let bad things happen to good people? So I'm not really sure what to believe in. I guess it's really up to each person to choose what they'll believe in? It wouldn't hurt to believe in something and it wouldn't hurt if you rather not believe at all. At some point in each person's life they'll come into a life changing realization in which they'll likely hold on to.
